card_config.value: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really Really Really Really Really Love You
Choose one character on your opponent's front line and switch it to resting. It will remain set to resting the next time it would be switched to active.

card_set: BOOSTER PACK The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You [UE21BT]
card_text:
[Activate: Main] #If on the Front Line# #Place 1 Card From Hand Into Sideline# 『Once Per Turn』 Reduce the required energy of all [Hanazono Family] affinity character cards by {Yellow×1} while in your hand until the end of the turn.
[When Attacking] Look at the top card of your deck. If that card has [Hanazono Family] affinity, you may reveal it and add it to your hand. Otherwise, place it on the top or bottom of your deck.
